manifestations.description: permanent weakness indicated by material muscle wastage
signs of early atrophic changes in the ankle
restricted movement in the ankle where osteoarthritic degenerative changes have already started
walks slowly with the aid of a stick and with an obvious limp
His effective range is of the order of half a mile
None of his former athletic pursuits are open and his capacity for play with his children is much reduced

treatments_received: fracture reduced and fixed with a plate and screws
external frame support fixed for left tibia/fibula
vascularised ilia bone graft (donor site right pelvis)
three skin grafting operations (donor site right thigh)
readmitted for procedures to check viability of the bone graft
removal of external support replaced by plaster (operation)
readmitted December 1986 for treatment for chronic ostelmyelitis in the injured left leg

losses.description: the present limb is only marginally better, functionally, than a prosthesis; 1¼ inches shortening; bowing and the disfiguration; permanent weakness indicated by material muscle wastage
scars and scar tissue from skin grafting operations
plaintiffs mobility and agility is markedly reduced. He walks slowly with the aid of a stick and with an obvious limp. His effective range is of the order of half a mile
